faq.q: How long should a mixer grinder motor last?
faq.a: A quality 500W mixer grinder motor (Bajaj, Prestige, Philips) lasts 5-8 years with regular use. Unbranded motors typically burn out within 12-18 months.

faq.q: Stainless steel or plastic jars — does it matter?
faq.a: Yes. Stainless steel jars are mandatory for any grinding that involves heat (chutneys, masalas). Plastic jars stain, absorb odors, and crack over time.
None of the mixer grinders under ₹2,000 have a proper overload protector. Bajaj and Philips have thermal cutoffs that trip if the motor overheats. For regular heavy use, budget for a 750W model.

tldr_pick: The Bajaj Rex 500W is the best mixer grinder under ₹2,000 in India in 2026 — verified 500W motor, three stainless steel jars, and a 2-year warranty from the widest service network in the country. Buy it at ₹1,799 on Amazon.
key_takeaways: 500W minimum: below 500W, even chutney grinding is a struggle.
Skip the unbranded '750W': actual output is closer to 400W — verified motor failure within 12-18 months.
Always stainless steel jars: plastic jars stain, absorb odors, and crack.
2-year warranty is the standard: Bajaj, Philips, and Maharaja Whiteline all offer it.
who_for: Anyone buying a first mixer grinder or replacing a failed one on a tight budget. If you cook Indian food daily (chutneys, idli batter, masalas) for 1-4 people, this guide ranks the 5 best options under ₹2,000.
